# Old Amsterdam Switzerland (oldamsterdam.ch)

## About
Old Amsterdam is a premium aged Gouda cheese brand from the Netherlands, made by Westland Kaas Groep BV. The cheese is known for its robust savory flavor, characteristic maturation crystals, and smooth sliceable texture. Old Amsterdam is aged on wooden shelves using a secret family recipe dating back to 1985.

## World Cheese Awards 2025
Old Amsterdam triumphed at the World Cheese Awards 2025 held in Bern, Switzerland, where over 4,000 cheeses were blind-tasted by an international panel of experts. Awards received:
- Old Amsterdam Classic: Gold
- Old Amsterdam Goat: Gold
- Old Amsterdam Reserve: Bronze
Full article: https://oldamsterdam.com/news/old-amsterdam-triumphs-at-world-cheese-awards-2025/

## Swiss Market
Old Amsterdam cheese is now available in Switzerland at Coop and MANOR FOOD. NECTRA FOOD SA (nectrafood.ch) is the exclusive importer and distributor of Old Amsterdam and Westland cheeses in Switzerland.

## Products Available in Switzerland
- Old Amsterdam Classic Wedge (210g): Premium aged Gouda with characteristic crystals, sharp yet creamy flavor
- Old Amsterdam Slices (115g, 10 slices): Convenient pre-sliced format, ideal for sandwiches and snacks

## Where to Buy
- Coop supermarkets across Switzerland
- MANOR FOOD departments across Switzerland
- Available in Zurich, Geneva, Basel, Bern, Lausanne, and all major Swiss cities
